# Camelot — Armenia, Quindío, Colombia

> Habitaciones privadas con baño propio y Wi-Fi en el centro de Armenia, Quindío. Estadías cortas, medianas y largas por noche, semana o mes. Reserva directa.

> Private hotel-style rooms with en-suite bath and Wi-Fi in downtown Armenia, Quindío, Colombia’s Coffee Region. Nightly, weekly and monthly rates. Book direct.

## Facts
- Type: private hotel-style rooms with private bathroom (short, medium and long stays)
- Location: city centre of Armenia, Quindío, Colombia (Coffee Cultural Landscape, UNESCO)
- Check-in 15:00 · Check-out 12:00
- Rooms: 14
- Medium stays (7+ nights): 15% off · Long stays (30+ nights): monthly rate, utilities and Wi-Fi included
- Languages on site: es, en, fr, de, pt
